project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript static-export portfolio site (GitHub Pages under base path /frankfabric/), with four interactive 3D demo widgets (chef, coach, wardrobe, virtual pet) built on three + @react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei + @pixiv/three-vrm.
build_system: npm + Next.js (next build with output:'export'). Node 22 must be on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH". Tailwind CSS 3 (tailwind.config.ts + app/globals.css).
test_framework: NONE. frankfabric has no unit-test suite. The gate is `npm run lint` (ESLint) + `npm run build` (clean static export). The user's '260 tests / npm run check' wording is from the tireshop reference and must NOT be applied here.
verification_instructions: 1) npm install. 2) npm run lint — expect exactly ONE pre-existing unrelated warning: @next/next/no-page-custom-font in app/layout.tsx; otherwise 0 errors/0 other warnings. 3) npm run build — static export must succeed; all five routes (/, /projects/chef-chatbot, /projects/coach-trainer, /projects/digital-wardrobe, /projects/virtual-pet) must keep prerendering; WebGL/DOM stays behind next/dynamic {ssr:false}. 4) Use scripts/measure-load.mjs (or a new sibling) with CHROME_PATH=/usr/local/bin/chrome to screenshot the built out/ at 390x844 and 1280x900 and assert document.scrollWidth <= viewport width per route.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked into source. docs/ holds evidence screenshots/JSON from prior workstreams (docs/perf, docs/visual, docs/motion). WS4 evidence MUST go under docs/a11y/ so it never overwrites the others. Never commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/frankfabric; export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; npm install. Chrome for the harness is at /usr/local/bin/chrome (symlink to bundled playwright chromium); set CHROME_PATH=/usr/local/bin/chrome. Network is OPEN_INTERNET.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22 only via the toolchains PATH (bare `node` is not found without it). Chrome is /usr/local/bin/chrome (no download). ASK BEFORE ADDING ANY DEPENDENCY — reduced-motion hook, focus styles, responsive Tailwind classes and ARIA need none. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that).
contribution_requirements: Work on a NEW branch off main named a11y/mobile-accessibility; commit there; do NOT push. Preserve WS1 (chunk split, SceneLoader/useProgress fallback, asset() for every public URL, cold-load byte budget — do NOT re-eager-preload), WS2 (shared High/Fast quality.ts + single QualityToggle as the ONLY quality control; ACESFilmic tone mapping + lighting rigs on all four scenes — do NOT touch), WS3 (interactions still route through chef/coach engines, lib/pet state, wardrobeOptions — no parallel path; engine behavior unchanged). Reduced-motion must GATE/scale motion, NOT rewrite pinned pose/transform/camera-framing constants. VRM skin/hair/brow tint constants + lib/vrm/* tint pipeline are FINAL. lib/data.ts + data/*.json are the only content source; do not hard-code content.
key_patterns: Each widget (ChefChatbot.tsx, CoachChatbot.tsx, WardrobeBuilder.tsx, pet/VirtualPet.tsx) wraps its stage in <QualityProvider>, dynamic-imports its *Scene via next/dynamic {ssr:false} with a loading fallback, and positions a shared <QualityToggle> in the stage corner. Widgets already stack via md:flex-row / lg:grid and carry sr-only labels, focus rings, aria-live logs, role=progressbar. Scenes chef/coach/pet Canvas already have role='img' + a short aria-label; wardrobe Canvas has NEITHER (must add). Scene motion lives in useFrame: avatar idle bob/sway, ambient particles (ChefScene wisp count 26/10, AtelierMotes 22/8), CameraRig nudge (chef/coach/wardrobe react to focus/lastChange), wardrobe OrbitControls autoRotate (animation==='rest'). Landing page uses tailwind CSS animations: animate-scan, animate-ticker, animate-marquee, animate-emberPulse, animate-ringSpin, animate-floatY (keyframes in tailwind.config.ts). There is currently NO prefers-reduced-motion handling and NO matchMedia anywhere in the repo.
directory_structure: app/ = routes (landing page.tsx + projects/<demo>/page.tsx wrappers). components/ = widgets (chef/, coach/, pet/, WardrobeBuilder.tsx, wardrobe/) + shared three/ infra (quality.ts, QualityToggle.tsx, SceneLoader.tsx). lib/ = engines (chef/, coach/), pet state (pet/), vrm tint pipeline (vrm/), asset() helper, data.ts. data/ = content JSON. scripts/ = measurement harnesses (measure-load.mjs cold-load+screenshot, measure-frametime.mjs). docs/ = per-workstream evidence (perf/visual/motion); WS4 goes under docs/a11y/. Reference-only tireshop lives at /projects/sandbox/tireshop (READ-ONLY; its WS4 was minimal — one 760px media query, no reduced-motion, no matchMedia).
